test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Article 7 of the Constitution of India, any person who has after the __________ migrated from the territory of India to the territory now included in Pakistan shall not be deemed to be a citizen of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st of March 1947.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 6__ **

 __
 
• Notwithstanding anything in **articles 5 and 6**, a person who has after the** first day of March, 1947**, migrated from the territory of India to the territory now included in Pakistan shall not be deemed to be a citizen of India:
 
• Provided that nothing in this article shall apply to a person who, after having so migrated to the territory now included in Pakistan, has returned to the territory of India under a permit for resettlement or permanent return issued by or under the authority of any law and every such person shall for the purposes of clause (b) of article 6 be deemed to have migrated to the territory of India after the nineteenth day of **July, 1948.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India **is the supreme law of India. 
 
• The document lays down the framework that demarcates fundamental political code, structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens
 
• The Republic is governed in terms of the Constitution of India which was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November, 1949** and came into force on** 26th January, 1950.**
 
• **Dr.** **Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar** is known as the father of the Indian Constitution.
